```{r}
data <- read.csv(file = "NASDAQ.tsv", sep = "\t")
write.table(data[, -1], file = "NASDAQ.dsv", sep = "\t")
```





```{r}
data <- read.csv(file = "NASDAQ.tsv", sep = "\t")

sub <- data[data$ticker == "BIIB", ]

mean(sub$open)
sd(sub$open)

dim(sub)

xi <- c(1:388)
yi <- c(1:388)

for(i in 1:388){
  yi[i] <- sub$open[i]

}
model <- lm(y ~ x, data = data.frame(x = xi, y = yi))
alpha <- summary(model)$coefficients[1, 1]
beta <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 1]
alpha
beta


sub


sort(sub, decreasing = FALSE, )





```




















```{r}


library(RSQLite)
db <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbname = "NASDAQ.sqlite")
dbWriteTable(conn = db, name = "BIIB", value = sub, overwrite = TRUE)






```
